summary: Keyboard-reachable code scroll regions in @kinetixui/ui 0.24.1, with tokens and CLI on the same 0.24.1 release line. On its independent Preview line, @kinetixui/angular 0.26.0 adds menus, listboxes, navigation, notifications and layout controls.

changes.title: CodeBlock and DiffViewer overflow is keyboard reachable
changes.body: Each scroll region takes a Tab stop only while it can scroll, with a visible focus ring. A CodeBlock showing a file is named by that file. No new props or exports.

changes.title: Minimal usage loads the complete token stylesheets
changes.body: The UI and tokens README examples include css/extras and css/extras/dark so focus rings and their dark variants are available.

changes.title: UI, tokens and CLI share 0.24.1
changes.body: UI carries the patch changes. Tokens and CLI move with the fixed Changesets cohort; neither has a separate feature change in this release.

changes.title: @kinetixui/angular 0.26.0 — still Preview
changes.body: Menus and submenus; select, command and multi-select; navigation menu, toasts, notification center, tour and sidebar; scroll area, resizable panels, carousel and comparison slider. Angular releases on its own version line.

limitations: Angular remains Preview. This release does not graduate it.
Tokens and CLI have no independent feature changes; their patch versions follow the fixed core cohort.
This release does not publish SwiftUI, Compose or Flutter packages.
